cues.en: Modeling Part four.
cues.zh: 建模第四部分。

cues.en: This is the final part of modeling and its comparison.
cues.zh: 最後一部分是比較。

cues.en: Wanting to know here is how will our model perform in the real world.
cues.zh: 想知道模型在真實世界表現如何。

cues.en: So after you've churned and improved your model's performance through hyper parameter tuning, it's time to see how it performs on the test set.
cues.zh: 調整超參數、改善模型效能後，該看看測試集表現。

cues.en: The test set is like the final exam for machine learning models.
cues.zh: 測試集就像模型的期末考。

cues.en: If you've created your data splits correctly, it should give you an indication on how your model will perform once deployed in production.
cues.zh: 資料正確切分後，應能反映部署到正式環境的表現。

cues.en: That means customer facing rather than just being on your local computer.
cues.zh: 也就是面向客戶，不只在自己的電腦。

cues.en: Since your model has never seen data in the test set, evaluating your model on it is a good way to see how it generalizes.
cues.zh: 模型從未看過測試資料，所以評估測試集，是了解泛化能力的好方法。

cues.en: And remember, by generalizing, I mean adapts to data it hasn't seen before, such as how our Heart
cues.zh: 泛化，就是適應未見資料；例如心臟，

cues.en: Disease Prediction Machine Learning model would perform at classifying whether a patient has heart disease or not on a patient who wasn't in our original data set.
cues.zh: 病預測模型，如何判斷原資料集裡沒有的新患者，是否有心臟病。

cues.en: A good model will yield similar results on the training, validation and test sets, and it's not uncommon
cues.zh: 好模型在訓練、驗證與測試集會有相似結果；但從訓練，

cues.en: to see a slight decline in performance from the model on the training and validation set to the test set.
cues.zh: 驗證到測試，表現略微下降很常見。

cues.en: For example, your model might achieve 98% accuracy on the training data set and 96% accuracy on the test set.
cues.zh: 例如訓練準確率 98%，測試準確率 96%。

cues.en: What you should be worried about is if the training set performance is dramatically higher than the test set, also known as unbefitting.
cues.zh: 要注意訓練表現遠高於測試；原字幕這裡卻把它稱為「擬合不足」。

cues.en: And if the test set performance is higher than the training set performance also known as overfitting.
cues.zh: 接著又把測試表現高於訓練，稱為「過度擬合」；這是此處的原說法。

cues.en: Overfitting and unbefitting of both examples of a model not being able to generalize well, which is what we don't want.
cues.zh: 過度擬合與擬合不足，都代表模型無法良好泛化，這不是我們想要的。

cues.en: The ideal model shows up in the Goldilocks zone.
cues.zh: 理想模型在恰到好處的區域，Goldilocks Zone。

cues.en: It fits just right.
cues.zh: 擬合剛剛好。

cues.en: Not too well, but not too poorly.
cues.zh: 不會太貼，也不會太差。

cues.en: You see here this this machine learning model, if this was your data, these green data points, this line here, it kind of fits the shape.
cues.zh: 這些綠點是資料，這條線大致配合形狀。

cues.en: But it's it's this would be classified as as under fitting.
cues.zh: 但這個例子會歸類為擬合不足。

cues.en: This is not what we want our model to do.
cues.zh: 不希望模型這樣。

cues.en: And this one over here, well, it's doing a good job of fitting all the data points, but it's going far too close.
cues.zh: 另一邊，模型很努力擬合全部資料點，卻貼得太近。

cues.en: It's almost a too perfect model.
cues.zh: 幾乎完美過頭。

cues.en: It's just snaking between them.
cues.zh: 在資料點之間蜿蜒穿梭。

cues.en: So this example would mean that the the model has learned the patterns too well in this data set.
cues.zh: 表示把這份資料的模式學得太過頭。

cues.en: It would be like seeing the final exam before actually taking the final exam.
cues.zh: 就像還沒考試，先看過期末試卷。

cues.en: This one here is the Goldilocks zone.
cues.zh: 這個才是恰到好處。

cues.en: Right.
cues.zh: 對。

cues.en: This is an iterative process where exactly this Goldilocks zone is like a balanced model.
cues.zh: 要透過迭代，找出這種平衡模型的區域。

cues.en: We really depend on your data and the problem you're trying to solve.
cues.zh: 具體在哪裡，取決於資料與問題。

cues.en: That's why, again, it's it's an iterative process, finding this this balanced zone.
cues.zh: 所以要不斷迭代，找出平衡。

cues.en: And now after some experience and practice working on different machine learning problems, you'll be able to start to tell whether your model is overfitting or under fitting.
cues.zh: 累積處理不同問題的經驗後，就能開始判斷模型是否過度擬合或擬合不足。

cues.en: Now there are several reasons why unbefitting and overfitting can happen, but the main ones are data leakage and data mismatch.
cues.zh: 兩者發生有許多原因，這裡主要談資料洩漏與資料不一致。

cues.en: Data leakage happens when some of your test data leaks into your training data, and this often results
cues.zh: 資料洩漏，就是部分測試資料跑進訓練資料；講者接著說，這通常導致，

cues.en: in overfitting or a model doing better on the test set than on the training data set.
cues.zh: 過度擬合，或模型在測試集比訓練集更好。

cues.en: It's like, remember, it was like if you were to have a look at the final exam or everyone had to look at the final exam as the practice exam, your machine learning model has just learned what it's about
cues.zh: 就像大家把期末試卷當模擬考，模型已經學過即將，

cues.en: to be test on.
cues.zh: 被測試的內容。

cues.en: So when it comes time to modelling, it's just learned it way too well and it starts to fit the data like this.
cues.zh: 所以建模時學得太熟，擬合成這樣。

cues.en: And this is why it's important to do your splits correctly and ensure that machine learning model training happens only on the training data set.
cues.zh: 因此要正確切分，確保模型只在訓練集訓練。

cues.en: Validation and model tuning happens only on the validation or training data set.
cues.zh: 驗證與調參，只在驗證或訓練集。

cues.en: And that testing and model comparison happens on the test data set.
cues.zh: 測試與比較，只在測試集。

cues.en: And I remember some different approaches.
cues.zh: 還記得有不同做法。

cues.en: Use only a training and testing set and do model tuning on the training set.
cues.zh: 有些只有訓練與測試集，在訓練集調參。

cues.en: But testing always stays the same.
cues.zh: 但測試的角色不變。

cues.en: It's like when you when you go to university, you're doing a course.
cues.zh: 就像在大學修課。

cues.en: You want to make sure that the final exam is kind of an indication of how well you understand things.
cues.zh: 希望期末考能反映真正理解程度。

cues.en: Same with the test data set for machine learning.
cues.zh: 模型的測試資料也一樣。

cues.en: The test data set is used as an indication of how well your model will generalize in the real world.
cues.zh: 用來判斷模型在真實世界如何泛化。

cues.en: So you want to avoid data leakage.
cues.zh: 所以要避免資料洩漏。

cues.en: Data mismatch happens when the data you're testing on is different to the data you're training on, such as having different features in the training data to the test data.
cues.zh: 資料不一致，就是測試資料與訓練資料不同，例如兩者特徵不同。

cues.en: Having this kind of mismatch can lead to models performing poorly on test data compared to training data.
cues.zh: 可能導致測試表現比訓練差。

cues.en: This is why it's important to ensure that training is done on the same kind of data as you'll be testing
cues.zh: 所以訓練應使用與測試相同類型，

cues.en: on and as close as possible to what you'll be using in your future applications.
cues.zh: 也盡量接近未來實際應用的資料。

cues.en: Other ways to combat unbefitting include using a more advanced model.
cues.zh: 改善擬合不足的另一個方法，是用更進階模型。

cues.en: This could mean a totally different model or increasing the number of hyper parameters on your current model.
cues.zh: 可能換個模型，或增加現有模型的超參數數量。

cues.en: Remember when we're cooking our chicken dish, we might alter one of the hyper parameters of our oven by turning it up.
cues.zh: 記得雞肉料理，可以把烤箱的其中一個超參數調高。

cues.en: That might be something that you might do on a machine learning model instead of only using two layers in a neural network you might use for.
cues.zh: 模型也可以，例如神經網路從 2 層改成 4 層。

cues.en: We'll see more of this in a future project.
cues.zh: 未來專案會看到更多。

cues.en: You could also reduce the number of features you're trying to model.
cues.zh: 也能減少要建模的特徵數。

cues.en: Maybe your data has too many features, and the model you're using is struggling to find patterns in them.
cues.zh: 也許資料特徵太多，模型很難找出模式。

cues.en: Finally, you could train your model for longer.
cues.zh: 最後，也可以訓練久一點。

cues.en: Sometimes models take longer to train or longer to learn than you'd expect.
cues.zh: 有時模型需要的學習時間，比想像長。

cues.en: One of your experiments may involve a longer training phase.
cues.zh: 實驗可以包含更長的訓練階段。

cues.en: To reduce overfitting.
cues.zh: 要降低過度擬合，

cues.en: Useful solutions are to collect more data.
cues.zh: 可以蒐集更多資料。

cues.en: More data will provide more potential patterns for a model to find and thus lower the potential for it to find them all.
cues.zh: 更多資料提供更多可能模式，降低模型把它們全部記住的機會。

cues.en: Or you could try use a less advanced model.
cues.zh: 或試著使用較簡單模型。

cues.en: This is uncommon, but it's possibility.
cues.zh: 這不常見，但有可能。

cues.en: The model you're using is too good at learning and it models your data too well.
cues.zh: 模型太擅長學習，把資料擬合得太好。

cues.en: Be cautious of models performing too well as they might lead to incorrect predictions.
cues.zh: 表現過好的模型也要留意，可能導致錯誤預測。

cues.en: Remember, no model is perfect, so be sure to check your good results as much as you check your poor results.
cues.zh: 沒有完美模型，所以好結果與差結果都要檢查。

cues.en: Finally, when comparing two different models to each other, it's important to ensure you're comparing apples with apples and oranges with oranges, for example.
cues.zh: 最後比較兩個模型時，要確保條件相當，例如，

cues.en: Model two Trained on data.
cues.zh: 模型 2 用資料集，

cues.en: Set one versus Model three trained on data, set one.
cues.zh: 1 訓練，與模型 3 同樣用資料集 1 訓練。

cues.en: And during comparison, you want to make sure you take into account not only the final result, but what it took to get there.
cues.zh: 比較時不只看最終結果，也要考慮付出的成本。

cues.en: If Model two takes 1/2 to make a prediction at 93.1% accuracy.
cues.zh: 模型 2 的預測時間，原字幕辨識為「1/2」，準確率 93.1%。

cues.en: Model three takes 4 seconds to make a prediction at 94.7 accuracy.
cues.zh: 模型 3 花 4 秒，準確率 94.7%。

cues.en: Is that extra 3% accuracy worth that extra 3 seconds of prediction time?
cues.zh: 講者接著問，多 3% 準確率，值得多 3 秒預測時間嗎？

cues.en: Now, this will depend on what the goal is, but if you are optimizing for prediction time, you want to make predictions as fast as possible.
cues.zh: 取決於目標；如果優先最佳化預測時間，希望越快越好，

cues.en: You might choose model two because it makes predictions four times faster than Model three, but at a higher accuracy level.
cues.zh: 可能選模型 2；講者說它快 4 倍，卻又說準確率更高，這裡原說法互有矛盾。

cues.en: Again, this will be different depending on on what kind of application or production use case you want to use.
cues.zh: 還是要看應用程式與正式環境用途。

cues.en: But just some things to keep in mind is more than just how a model performs that goes into choosing which one you should use.
cues.zh: 重點是，選模型不能只考慮模型表現。

cues.en: A couple of things you want to remember from this lesson Avoid overfitting and unbefitting.
cues.zh: 這堂記住幾點，避免過度擬合與擬合不足。

cues.en: You want a model that heads towards generality.
cues.zh: 希望模型朝良好泛化發展。

cues.en: It's like when you do your practice exam, if you saw the final exam, you might just become an expert memorization machine rather than someone who could use their knowledge in the real world.
cues.zh: 像練習時先看期末考，可能只成為很會背答案的人，無法在真實世界運用知識。

cues.en: Keep the test set separate at all costs.
cues.zh: 務必保持測試集獨立。

cues.en: When you split your data, you want to have a training set and then throw away the test data set and lock it up.
cues.zh: 切分資料後，保留訓練集，把測試集收起來鎖好。

cues.en: And once your model has been trained, then you can open up the test data set, you can unlock it, take it out of the safe and see how your model performs when you're comparing models.
cues.zh: 模型訓練完成，要比較時，才解鎖、取出測試集，檢查表現。

cues.en: Compare apples to apples, have model one and model two on data, set one and data set one.
cues.zh: 公平比較，模型 1 和模型 2 都使用相同資料集 1。

cues.en: You want to make sure the two models you're comparing have been created in the same sort of environment so that you can ensure that what you're comparing is is legitimate comparisons.
cues.zh: 確保比較的模型在相同類型環境建立，結果才是有效比較。

cues.en: Finally, one best performance metric does not equal the best model.
cues.zh: 最後，單一最佳指標不代表最佳模型。

cues.en: Remember, in our example, you may be optimizing for prediction time.
cues.zh: 還記得，例子裡可能優先考慮預測速度。

cues.en: So although a model that makes a faster prediction doesn't get as high accuracy as is another model that takes a little bit longer.
cues.zh: 較快模型也許沒有較慢模型那麼高的準確率。

cues.en: It might not matter to you because you need something that can predict as fast as possible.
cues.zh: 但不一定重要，因為需求是盡快預測。

cues.en: Phew, that was a lot, but we'll see plenty more of this in action throughout the course.
cues.zh: 內容很多，之後實作還會看到。

cues.en: You'll also be using it throughout your entire machine learning career, so it's important to remember these concepts.
cues.zh: 整個機器學習職涯都會使用，記住這些概念很重要。

cues.en: Let's push on to the next step and see how we can put all of this previous steps together in step six experimentation.
cues.zh: 進入下一步，看看第六步實驗，如何把前面串起來。
